# openvicloud_firewall_rule (Resource)

One rule in the firewall (ACL) of a network. Every change replaces the rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openvicloud_firewall_rule" "ssh" {
  network_id = openvicloud_network.web.id
  direction  = "Ingress"
  protocol   = "TCP"
  start_port = 22
  end_port   = 22
  cidr       = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Addresses the rule applies to, e.g. 0.0.0.0/0.
- `direction` (String)
- `network_id` (String) Network whose firewall holds the rule.
- `protocol` (String)

### Optional

- `end_port` (Number) Last port, required for TCP and UDP; at least start_port.
- `start_port` (Number) First port, required for TCP and UDP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openvicloud_firewall_rule.ssh <network id>/<rule id>
```
